# ui::Vector3Transition

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

Animates every change to an element's translation or scale ([Element::set_translation_transition()](element.md#set_translation_transition), [Element::set_scale_transition()](element.md#set_scale_transition)), with [ScalarTransition](scalar-transition.md)'s curve.

Example: 
```cpp
auto element = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
element->set_translation_transition(ui::Vector3Transition{.components = ui::Vector3Components::Y});
element->set_translation(ui::Vector3{20.0f, 40.0f, 0.0f}); // y glides, x snaps
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `Duration` | `{300.0}` | Length of each transition. |
| `components` | `Vector3Components` | `Vector3Components::All` | Which components animate. |
